help.title: Quick Start for Agents Manager
help.description: Install resources into the Library, choose a preset to edit, then use Global or Project Workspaces to manage what agents load. Open Sync for shared host state. Press ⌘K for navigation and this guide.

workflows.title: Recommended Workflows
workflows.description: Library: choose a viewed preset and edit its membership. Global Workspace: switch the shared active preset or add a skill to an agent. Project Workspace: add or remove preset skills for that project. Sync: join hosts to a shared library; each follows the shared active preset on its next successful sync.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: The viewed preset is the one you inspect and edit in Library; selecting it does not switch agents. The shared active preset determines what agents load on hosts in Sync. Switching can remove skills added directly; review the affected host and agent changes first. Project preset actions only add or remove skills in that project. Edited copies are preserved for review.

install.title: Install Skills
install.description: Import from local folders, Git repositories, archives, or the marketplace. Batch-import multiple skills from a folder at once.

sync.title: Library
sync.description: Browse Skills, Instructions and MCP definitions. In preset indicates membership in the viewed preset; On agents shows actual skill presence. Open a skill to inspect its source and content. Adding a skill to the library does not by itself add it to an agent.

global.title: Global Workspace
global.description: Each agent gets its own page listing every skill in its global folder — including ones added outside Agents Manager — so the view matches what the agent actually sees. Use + Add Skills to pull from your central library with inline target-agent chips, or use the All Agents overview to manage every installed agent at once. Skills that only exist in an agent folder can be deleted directly from the card.

projects.title: Project Workspaces
projects.description: Link a project to browse per-agent local skill folders, compare with the central library, and import or export changes. Use Preset pills to activate skill groups, or open + Add Skills to pick from your library with a multi-agent target picker.

backup.title: Sync
backup.description: Open Sync to connect the shared library and inspect participating hosts. Needs review lets you compare conflicting versions before choosing what to keep. History provides recovery points. Credentials and host-specific operational data stay local.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage agent paths and toggles, add custom agents, drag to reorder how agents appear across the app, change how skills are added to agents, theme, text size, language, proxy, Git remote, AI search key, and check for app updates. Use Export Logs to bundle recent logs and install/remove/update/sync activity into a single zip when filing an issue.

remoteHosts.title: Hosts
remoteHosts.description: Manage skills on another host that has Agents Manager, over your existing SSH setup. Nothing is stored here but the address; keys and ssh config do the authentication.
remoteHosts.removeConfirm: Remove host "{{name}}"? Its library and the skills on its agents stay.
remoteHosts.alsoLeaveSyncHint: Deletes its access key on GitHub now and stops its sync timer. Unchecked, the host keeps syncing on its own.
remoteHosts.deleteKeyByHand: GitHub didn't delete the host's key. Delete "{{key}}" under the Sync repository's Settings > Deploy keys.

form.name: Name
form.sshTargetPlaceholder: user@host or an ssh config alias
form.cliPathPlaceholder: Leave empty to find it on the host

remoteHosts.probeIncompatible: Agents Manager there is {{version}}; this app is {{appVersion}}. Both must run the same version to connect.
remoteHosts.updatePendingHint: The CLI on this host is behind this app. It updates on the next start or connect.
remoteHosts.updateDescription: Check this host’s CLI version, then install the matching version if needed.
remoteHosts.cliOnlyNotice: This installs a dedicated CLI for this connection and selects it for this host. It upgrades the host’s skill library database, so Agents Manager on that host must already run this version or newer.
remoteHosts.installedReconnectFailed: The matching CLI is installed, but the host could not reconnect.
remoteHosts.installedButNotReconnected: The CLI is installed. Reconnect to this host when ready.

remoteSession.backupLocalBody: This page manages this computer’s backup. {{name}} backs up from its own Agents Manager to the same repository.

remotePicker.emptyFile: No folders or matching files here.

review.title: Compare {{name}}
review.unavailable: Comparison is unavailable. The host may need a matching CLI version, or the resource may have changed. Refresh to try again.
review.explanation: Inspect both versions before choosing. Missing files are shown as additions or removals; binary and large files show a summary.
review.outcome: Apply this choice to the shared library? Other hosts follow it on their next successful sync. The current state remains in Sync history for recovery.
review.editedOutcome: Apply this choice to the selected agent copy? “Use Sync version” moves the edit to edited-backups before replacing it or removing it from this agent. “Keep my edit” leaves its files in place.
review.applied: {{name}}: {{choice}} applied. Review Sync history for shared-library recovery.
review.editedApplied: {{name}}: {{choice}} applied to this agent copy. Replaced edits remain in edited-backups.

workspace.presenceHint: Actual presence · select a cell to stage changes
workspace.matrixLegend: Check: on agent · Plus: not on agent · Dashed outline and label: staged change
workspace.reviewDescription: Only these resource and agent pairs will change. Review the destination and any local-edit warnings before applying.
workspace.leaveDescription: You have {{count}} target changes that have not been applied. Keep editing or discard them before changing context.
workspace.inventoryChanged: The target changed since review. Discard and restage the affected changes using the refreshed inventory.
workspace.editedProtection: Edited here. Review the local copy before removing it.
workspace.directWarning: Global additions are added directly on this host. A later shared preset switch can remove them.
workspace.localRemovalWarning: Removing {{name}} from {{agent}} deletes local files at {{path}}. Any local edits in this copy will be lost.
workspace.browseHint: Browsing this preset does not change agents.
workspace.projectPresetScope: Only this project changes. The shared active preset stays unchanged.
workspace.multipleDirectories: Multiple deployment directories. Manage this resource to review each location.
workspace.nameConflict: A connection with this name exists. Manage the definition to choose how to resolve it.
workspace.detachInstructions: Only unchanged managed files are removed. Edited local files are preserved and detached.
workspace.removeMcp: Remove the managed connection from this agent. Edited entries are preserved and detached; credentials stay outside the app.
workspace.reviewConflictsInEditor: This target has conflicting edits. Open the resource and resolve them in its deployment preview.
workspace.mcpCredentials: Adding an MCP definition does not authenticate or verify the connection.
workspace.interrupted: The operation was interrupted. Open the resource recovery tools before retrying.
workspace.worktreeEditor: Use Manage definitions and content to browse worktrees, nested instruction files or deployment subdirectories.
workspace.managedPresenceHint: Managed library deployments · native files and imports are available in details.

operations.originalHostMissing: The original host is missing or its connection identity changed. This result stays attached to its original destination.
operations.reviewDescription: Review the freshly prepared skills and names, then confirm the selected installations.
operations.saveFailed: Could not save operation results. They remain available in this session.
operations.unknownHelp: The result could not be verified. Work may still be running on this host. Reconnect to check without repeating changes.
operations.refreshFailed: Changes finished, but project refresh failed.

phase.needs_review: Needs review — your copy was kept

operations.otherResults: {{unchanged}} already up to date · {{unknown}} outcome unknown
operations.libraryRefreshFailed: Installation results are recorded. The library could not be refreshed.

shutdown.title: Quit with unfinished work?
shutdown.description: Work stays on its original host. Canceling keeps completed changes and waits for current writes to finish safely. An unreachable host may still be working. Unresolved results are saved before quitting.
shutdown.autoQuit: Quit automatically when all work finishes
shutdown.draining: Waiting for all work, including new work. {{count}} unfinished.
shutdown.canceling: Stopping unfinished work safely. Completed changes are kept.
shutdown.saveError: Could not save results. The app is still open. Retry saving to quit.
shutdown.savingDescription: Unresolved results will be available next launch. Keep the app open to continue working.
shutdown.willQuit: The app will quit when work finishes.
shutdown.willRestart: The app will restart when work finishes.
shutdown.willUpdate: The app will install the update and close when work finishes.
